### Hermogenes David Rios

I am Hermogenes David Rios, a rising senior studying Economics and Statistics at [Macalester College](https://www.macalester.edu) in Saint Paul, Minnesota. I am drawn to work that uses data and economics to understand how policy shapes education and labor market opportunity. Learn more [about me](./experience.html).


### Highlights

[**Founder of *Camino a la U*:**](/posts/camino/) In January 2026, I received a \$2,000 Live It Fund grant from Macalester's [Entrepreneurship and Innovation Department](https://www.macalester.edu/entrepreneurship-and-innovation/turning-vision-into-action-live-it-fund-j-term-2026-projects/) to found *Camino a la U*, a university-access program for low-income students in Santa Cruz, Bolivia. I designed the selection process and organized five teachers to coach students through admission essays and entrance exams, raising average admission-exam scores by 52 percentage points (from 32% to 84%).

[**Author of "Inequalities in the U.S. Labor Market":**](/posts/metrics/) Quantified labor market disparities using regression analysis on 500K+ census records. Published in the *Macalester Street Journal: Equilibrium*, Vol. 3 (2025).
